audience.role: Plugin users, 0.6.1 upgraders and maintainers assessing candidate risk and release readiness

checks.note: READMEs support first use; changelogs record version changes; the release draft summarizes 0.7.0; security and acceptance documents explain risk and evidence. Schema maps the latter two to release_notes.
Each README identifies prerequisites, conditional installation, locale command, model choice, expected local files and waiting. Upgrade notes explain native 0.6.1 resume and separate CLI updates.
Entry paths name session input and report output before advanced concepts; security policy explains the unresolved dependency gap and its limits.
Both changelogs and other current documents consistently describe a new limited risk decision, non-clean local scan results and pending replacement and exact-commit CI.
Prerequisites, dependency risk and model-provider handling are stated before the affected actions; candidate status and pending checks appear near the release draft and acceptance openings.

English, Chinese and Russian README paths were read independently. English and Chinese changelogs and release sections are consistent; detailed security policy and Russian changelog are unavailable in Russian.

findings.message: The broad 0.6.1 resume statement could identify legacy Python runs as CLI-only, as SECURITY.md:46 explains.
The Russian README summarizes the risk, but detailed policy and reassessment triggers are in English; the linked changelog and release notes are not in Russian.

limitations: Eight named documents only; SECURITY.md and the acceptance record use release_notes as the closest schema role, and the bilingual release draft uses default language.
The review assesses readability and internal document consistency; it does not establish factual correctness or operational behavior.
Source, native, model, UI, exact-commit CI, artifact freeze and publication were not verified by this review.
Detailed security policy is English; no Russian changelog or release-note section was reviewed. External links and operational commands were not tested.
Replacement artifact, affected installation identity checks and exact-commit CI are documented as pending; any bound document edit invalidates this receipt.
